This site is designed to keep residents informed, to help town leaders communicate and to aid those new to the area in the process of getting to know us.
Contact information for all departments, committees, town officials and staff can be found on the
Hours and Information page
or through the board, committee and department pages in the menus above. Minutes of the most recent meetings are posted on those pages.
Please note: Office hours and days of operation vary among departments. Please check each individual web page for specifics.
